shared_elements: standing human figures in strict profile
elaborate curled/beaded hairstyle and beard rendered as regular rows of dots or curls
long pleated/draped robe with parallel folds
figures carrying or holding objects (spear, bow; carried offerings, harness)
procession-like alignment of figures along a horizontal register
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures with identically conventionalised beaded/curled hair and beard, long pleated robes, and carried attributes, arranged in horizontal registers bounded by a rosette-decorated band — a highly specific and conventional combination unlikely to arise independently. The chief difference in depicted content is that A isolates a single armed guard with spear and bow filling the field, while B shows a multi-figure procession with a horse's head and carried objects at smaller scale.
